ios.desc:
Podcast Player is an advanced Podcast playback app.


Podcast Player has pioneered many features that are commonplace today and continues to evolve. 

ADVANCED 

• Silence remover for audio podcasts, saves hours per week for the average listener without affecting sound quality 
• Clearer audio with equalizer, compressor / limiter and volume boosting DSP effects (on video, streaming and downloads) 
• Keep multiple devices in Sync with iCloud 

EFFICIENT 

• Organize your listening by categories  
• Server side refreshing and push notifications 
• Podcast Player is carefully developed and tuned to be nice to your battery 

FLEXIBLE 

• Download or stream any size show over WiFi or 3G 
• Fully supports password protected podcasts, including 1Password support 
• Built in sleep timer  
• Light / Dark UI themes 
• Play only the audio part of videos, if you like 

SMART 

• Extensive directory of Podcasts, search for shows by keyword, category, view the top podcasts or enter a URL manually 
• Find new shows from Podcast Player users listening patterns. Podcast Player can suggest shows you might like based on your existing subscriptions. 

Podcast Player is free, with ads. Try it now.

PEOPLE SAY: 

"Podcast Player mobile is a very solid offering in the podcast app space. The app is very stable and offers some nice features" - AppAdvice.com  

"I have found that Podcast Player is one of the fastest podcasting apps when it comes to managing feeds and downloading episodes. At the moment, no other app has been able to match it when it comes to managing those basic tasks." - Geoffrey Goetz "Podcasting 101"  

"Podcast Player is the perfect option for a beginning podcaster." - Emily. C. Gardener / gretchenlouise.com
